name: Ljubljana 2D/3D registration gold standard (PIXIUM 4600)

pairing.ct: five CT volumes, one per vertebra L1 to L5, and five MR volumes the same way
pairing.pose: stored: a gold-standard rigid transform for each vertebra's CT and MR volume, and each X-ray's sensor pose and source position in its header
pairing.masks: none shipped; each vertebra comes as a volume of its own
pairing.annotate: five body masks kept beside the set, never inside it and never shared, since the licence allows no derivatives
pairing.pair_key: one specimen: every X-ray pairs with the five vertebra volumes through their transforms

what: 18 X-ray images of one cadaver lumbar spine with fiducial markers, L1 to L5, each with its sensor pose and source position in its header; five CT and five MR volumes, one per vertebra, each with a gold-standard rigid transform to the X-rays; the flat panel is a PIXIUM 4600 as SchwingNet's registry records it, which neither the source's page nor its user guide names
level_truth: L1 to L5: each vertebra is its own CT and MR volume, placed on every X-ray by its gold-standard transform and the X-ray's header geometry

segmentations.masks: no masks: each vertebra, L1 to L5, comes as a CT and an MR volume of its own, so the volume names the level

licence: CC BY-NC-ND, as the source's page gives it (read 2026-10-23); the user guide that comes with the set says the data are used only under an agreement form between the user and the Laboratory of Imaging Technologies, and never redistributed
how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/ljubljana, fetched by the owner; nothing to fetch.

To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/ljubljana_2d3d_gs/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23

history.note: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/ljubljana, fetched by the owner, before the shared tree and its promoter existed; the record written for the census (#178) from SchwingNet's registry

the source's page (the link) and its user guide read: CC BY-NC-ND on the page, an agreement form with the Laboratory of Imaging Technologies in the guide; five CT and five MR volumes, one per vertebra, each with a gold-standard rigid transform, and 18 X-ray images whose headers give the sensor pose and source position, where the record had one CT and a pose per frame; neither names the X-ray device; link, licence, what, level truth, pairing and counts corrected

obstacles: the owner's hand: the source's page gives CC BY-NC-ND (non-commercial, no derivatives) and its user guide an agreement form with the lab; which terms govern, and whether the project uses the copy on the grid under them, is his decision
